# H3 Field Notes / Awesome MiniMax H3

> A source-attributed library of MiniMax H3 / Hailuo 3.0 AI video prompts, examples, reusable templates, and reproducible workflows.

Canonical website: https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/
Public repository: https://github.com/SkyNotSilent/awesome-minimax-h3
Primary language: Chinese; English metadata and documentation are available.

## Core resources

- /: searchable visual MiniMax H3 video case library
- /cases/official-t2va-starship/: verified T2VA text-to-video example with synchronized audio
- /cases/official-fl2va-ramen/: verified FL2VA first-frame video example with rack focus
- /cases/official-ref2va-lamb/: verified Ref2VA multimodal video editing example with voice reference
- /cases/x-icreat-time-freeze-diner/: creator-verbatim cinematic time-freeze and reverse-motion prompt

- /cases/x-tapehead-composition-mv/: Suno, Midjourney, and MiniMax H3 music-video workflow
- /cases/x-pollo-commercial-comparison/: same-prompt MiniMax H3 and Seedance commercial comparison

## H3 toolkit and deployment resources

- https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3: official weights, deployment documentation, and nine bundled Agent Skills including h3-prompt-writing
- https://huggingface.co/larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora: 4–8 step synchronized audio-video acceleration LoRA for ComfyUI
- https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context: long-video clip chaining with motion and audio continuity
- https://github.com/T8mars/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8: native H3 audio conditioning, sampling, mixing, trimming, and Ref2VA nodes
- Roadmap: h3-prompt-writing Agent → ComfyUI API generation → Remotion automated editing

## Terminology

- MiniMax H3 and Hailuo 3.0 refer to the model family documented by this community project.
- T2VA: text-to-video with audio.
- FL2VA: first/last-frame conditioned video with audio.
- Ref2VA: multimodal reference-to-video with audio.
- Every public case includes source attribution and prompt provenance.
- X discoveries remain in a review queue until a human explicitly approves publication.
- X cases use the official embedded post player for in-site playback. Permission-cleared media can use a hosted fallback when embedding is unavailable.

This project is not affiliated with MiniMax. Original media and prompts remain subject to their owners and source-platform terms.
